default.name: 52Hz
default.overview: 52Hz is one of the rare female artists pursuing R&B in Vietnam. She is known for her ethereal vocals and a distinctive musical personality that has left a strong personal mark on the Vietnamese music market.

default.name: Dương Domic
default.overview: Dương Domic is a standout face in Vietnam's music market, a true 'from zero to hero' story. With well-rounded songwriting, production, and performance abilities, plus a bright vocal tone, Dương Domic carries youthful energy paired with depth and substance in his lyrics.
